edits.old: Then the accounts are taken again when an EXCLUSION version is in force
edits.new:
Then the accounts are taken again when an EXCLUSION version is in force

  Scenario: AC16 The yearly case number range is used up (exception X5)
    Given the yearly case number sequence for 2026 is at 999999
    When AceDataReady is raised for ALS and 2026-12-01 and JOB-02 runs
    Then the system creates no case for the account
    Then the job record carries the range line with the year 2026 and MSG-P3-025
    Then an incident goes to the platform administrator

  Scenario: AC17 The decision of the creation cannot be recorded (exception X6)
    Given the decision log store is unavailable for account A-5001 at creation
    When AceDataReady is raised for ALS and 2026-12-01 and JOB-02 runs
    Then the system creates no case for account A-5001
    Then the run reports account A-5001 as failed with MSG-P7-003
    Then account A-5001 is taken again in the next run

  Scenario: AC18 A suite step cannot read a service schema directly (exception X10)
    Given a suite step is written to read the schema of a service directly
    When the pipeline scan runs on the change
    Then the scan fails the change
    Then the suite has no client for a service schema and the step does not run

  Scenario: AC19 Case rules hold across the wave 1 services (BR9, BR10, BR14, BR15, BR16, BR17, BR18)
    Given case RW-2026-000123 is created on account A-5001 with its exposure band set from the total outstanding at entry using the band table in force
    When a repeated readiness signal for 2026-12-01 is received and the case is canceled by rule
    Then the repeated signal adds no case and no link, and the case is canceled and not deleted
    Then the creation commits in rwb-case with its outbox row and leaves as rwb.case.CaseCreated.v1 on rwb.case.events.v1, and the suite reads no copy of it
    Then the suite reads every service only through its contract, with no cross-service table read
    Then every REST call of the run reaches its owning service in one hop within the 2 s client budget
    Then the events, logs, workflow history and fixtures carry account keys, person keys, case numbers, rule IDs, package versions and business dates only

  Scenario: AC20 A retried or timed-out activity follows its retry and timeout settings (section 12)
    Given an activity of the run fails and is retried under the retry settings of section 12
    When the retries are exhausted or the activity exceeds its timeout in section 12
    Then the run records each attempt and the timeout in the job record
    Then the retried activity creates no second case and no second link
